failure_summary.description: Answers were over-specific or used a longer form than the requested target: an NFL variant, an expanded show title, an exact year instead of a century, or a company suffix.
The agent returned an associated work instead of the person requested, or repeated a list instead of giving the expected single answer.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directs agents to identify the requested answer slot, match its specificity, use an unambiguous shorter name when appropriate, and give only the minimal answer. These failures reflect nonapplication of those rules; the bare-list case does not support a reliable new general rule.
